data.body: CI infrastructure retry: Gerrit Verified run 31118460333 failed before repository execution because GitHub could not resolve action download metadata (Internal Server Error), then remained stuck in setup after normal and force cancellation. The documented Gerrit recheck created run 31119586551 but it queued behind the stuck concurrency lock; that queued duplicate was canceled. Workflow inspection confirmed GERRIT_CHANGE_ID is used only for the concurrency group, while checkout/voting use the exact change number, patchset, revision, project, and refspec. Dispatched full gate run 31119693198 with one-time retry lock key and exact Gerrit 1451 patchset 1 coordinates; no code or patchset changed.
